transcript:
Priya: Thanks for joining. The login bug is the top priority.
Ravi: I'll fix the login timeout by Friday.
Priya: Meena, can you update the release notes?
Meena: Sure.

Sara: The client wants the export in CSV as well as PDF.
Aditya: I'll send them a revised quote by Monday.
Sara: Someone needs to check whether the CSV export breaks the audit log.

Kabir: The demo went well yesterday.
Lena: Agreed, the client liked the dashboard. Nothing else from me.

Nisha: The outage lasted 40 minutes.
Omar: I will write the postmortem by tomorrow.
Nisha: We need to add an alert on queue depth.
Ravi: Omar will also rotate the leaked token.

Dev: The pitch deck needs a pricing slide.
Priya: Let's have Dev own the pricing slide for Thursday.
Dev: Fine. I'll think about the colour scheme too.

Meena: Legal has to sign off on the data processing agreement.
Kabir: Can someone chase legal for the signed agreement before Wednesday?
Meena: I'll book the security review.

Ravi: I already deployed the hotfix this morning.
Sara: Great. Ravi, could you share the rollback steps with support?
Sara: I'll update the status page by end of day.

Lena: The onboarding emails are confusing.
Omar: Yeah, maybe we could look at that at some point.
Lena: Omar will draft three new subject lines by next week.

Nisha: I'll clean up the test data and I'll rerun the evaluation by Friday.
Aditya: Can anyone review the schema change?

Meena: I'm on leave next week, so the vendor call needs cover.
Sara: I can take the vendor call.
Dev: I'll send Sara the vendor contract today.
